name: services/slips/issue_slip
description: Issue a new slip instance. The issued slip will initially be closed, so that it can be edited before its questions begin to be answered.

arguments.name: tpl_id
arguments.description: ID of the slip template to be used for the slip.

arguments.name: client_user_id
arguments.description: ID of the user to whom the slip is to be issued.

arguments.name: student_programme_id
arguments.description:
Optional ID of the student's programme which is said to be "bound" to
	the issued slip instance.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
{"success": true, "slip_id": "<id of the new slip>"}

In case of failure, use the user_messages field to display a proper message for the user.
